regions.name: Guaporé
regions.quote: The three-striped apisto, Apistogramma trifasciata, is a dwarf cichlid from the Guaporé, Paraguay and middle Paraná basins.

regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Arroyo Chagalalina' in Paraguay but this species has a relatively wide distribution extending southwards from the rio Guaporé drainage in the southern Amazon basin though the connected rio Paraguay watershed in Brazil and Paraguay and on as far as the middle Paraná (of which the Paraguay is a major tributary) basin in Argentina.
